product_metadata.title: Linenspa 6 Inch Innerspring Full Mattress with Foam Layer - Firm Feel - CertiPUR-US Certified - Mattress in a Box, White
features: General Note: Please allow 24 - 72 hours for your Mattress to regain its full shape. Any memory foam will expand faster in a warmer room. In cold temperature, at delivery, your mattress may take a bit longer to return to full sized from its compressed state.The expansion time of the mattress will vary as per the surrounding.Set Up: Simply take your mattress out of the box and enjoy watching it decompress. Jumping, walking, and sleeping on your mattress can speed up the process.
DURABLE AND SOFT: Heavy gauge tempered steel coils provide consistent support, while the quilted fabric cover and deep foam layer ensure comfortable sleep
VERSATILE PROFILE: Firm mattress is ideal for guest beds, RV beds, or growing teenagers. Great for back or stomach sleepers
PICK YOUR FRAME: This mattress can be used with a box spring, slatted frame, platform bed, or metal grid to work with any bed frame
COMPACT COMFORT: Full size mattress measures 54” (W) x 75” (L) x 6” (D)
EASY INSTALL: Remove mattress from packaging within 72 hours and allow 48-72 hours for proper decompression before using
Materials: Cover: 100% Polyester. Inner Material: 62% Polyester Fiber, 18% Rayon Fiber, 15% Polyurethane Foam, 5% Polypropylene Fiber
description: A traditional innerspring mattress meets everyday value in the Linenspa 6-inch Bonnell Spring Mattress. A quilted fabric cover and inner foam layer provide comfort and resilience, while heavy gauge steel coils offer lasting support. The full mattress is perfect for guest beds, RV beds, or still-growing teenagers. As an added measure, this 6 inch mattress has a fire-resistant barrier that's tested to ensure it meets safety standards. This convenient full size mattress in a box ships compressed and rolled, ready for easy setup.

details.Care instructions: DO NOT REMOVE OR WASH . Spot Clean only. To spot clean, Vacuum your mattress, sprinkle some baking soda on it. Use a scrub brush to gently rub the powder into the mattress and leave it for 10 minutes or so. Vacuum the excess powder. Do not wash. Do not use bleach. Do not machine dry. Do not iron. Do not dry clean.
